prompt: Use exactly the art style of the reference image: loose watercolour washes over a fine, slightly wobbly hand-drawn black ink line, granulating watercolour paper texture, soft and hand-made. Four separate street-level buildings of a crumbling modern town, each two storeys at most: 1) a corner shop with a pulled-down metal roller shutter and a torn awning, 2) an old arcade hall with a big empty marquee sign frame ringed with unlit bulbs, 3) a shop with a striped awning and a small flat above with glowing windows, 4) a little laundromat with a round empty sign frame.
